newsitem.title: UK: Bullough shares bounce on restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Bullough shares bounce on restructuring.

text.p: Shares in Bullough Plc rose sharply on Thursday after investors were encouraged by the company's restructuring and overlooked a fall in pre-tax profits, traders said.
The shares rose 14-1/2p, or 18.95 percent, to 91p by 0915 GMT. Earlier the company posted annual pretax profits of 7.99 million stg, down 45 percent from the previous year.
"This was discounted in the share price," one trader said. "We think that from now on in the worst is over and it's onwards and upwards for Bullough."
The stock has fallen steadily over the past two years since reaching a peak of 190p in June 1995.
Since October, the refrigeration, heating and engineering group has sold off nine companies in a major restructuring plan.
"The restructuring makes it look like a whole new company," another trader said.
